title: Every Thursday I visit my ex's storage unit. Someone else does too.
description:
Every Thursday at seven, I let myself into unit seven and sit with the boxes my ex never came back for. The corridor lights run on a one-minute timer, and the button is a long walk away in the dark.

The first week, somebody was standing in the open doorway of unit eleven. From the front they looked ordinary. Each Thursday after that, they were one door nearer mine.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Which boxes was I sitting on every Thursday, the round scribbles or the jagged ones?
